races.name: Best Ticket Deals Online leicester-racecourse.co.uk Nursery Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Aura Of Melania
runners_data.comment: Yet to score in her last three starts (4th, 4th, 6th, latest 19 days ago), she returns over a trip already tackled from stall 8, and a rating of 62 marks her the leading danger to our selection.

runners_data.name: Bluestone Lady
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in six starts (2nd, 4th, 6th, 2nd, 6th, 8th) but twice runner-up in that sequence and already raced over today's trip. A rating of 61 from stall 4 keeps her among the leading dangers to our selection.

runners_data.name: Emerald Bay
runners_data.comment: Won last time out having been 6th, 7th and unplaced in the three starts before that, and returns just 10 days on. Already proven over today's trip from stall 10, though a rating of 56 leaves him with plenty to find against the leaders.

runners_data.name: Hamdani Mokhater
runners_data.comment: Modest form figures — 5th, 7th, 5th in his last three — undersell him: a rating of 72 makes him top of this field, well clear of his official mark of 60. Back after a 31-day break over a trip already proven from stall 5, the layoff is the only concern.

runners_data.name: Agnes Hathaway
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in four runs (6th, 9th, 7th, 8th) and without a top-half finish in that sequence, though fit again just 12 days on and with today's trip no issue from stall 2. A rating of 60 — above her official mark of 56 — offers a sliver of encouragement.

runners_data.name: Alpaca's Bullet
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in three starts (9th, 7th, 8th) and out of the frame throughout, with 43 days since that last run to find improvement. A rating of 58 from stall 9 edges her official mark of 54, but the form read is thin.

runners_data.name: Le Grand Etoile
runners_data.comment: 5th, unplaced and 9th in his last three starts leave him bottom of these ratings at 50, a shade under his official mark of 51. A 27-day break and a proven trip from stall 7 do little to boost confidence in this profile.

runners_data.name: Magical Life
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in four starts (5th, 4th, 5th, unplaced), a rating of 61 nonetheless puts her well clear of her official mark of 51. Fit again just 12 days on over a trip already proven from stall 6, she looks the value danger to our selection.

runners_data.name: Tiger In The Tree
runners_data.comment: A modest sequence of 3rd, 9th, 6th and 9th in her last four leaves her without a win and rated only 50 — level with her official mark. Quick to run again just 10 days on over a proven trip from stall 1, but the form offers little encouragement.

runners_data.name: Postcard
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in four starts (7th, 6th, 9th, 8th), though a rating of 53 sits well above her official mark of 45. Backed up quickly just 6 days after her last run over a trip already covered from stall 3, but the placings so far are hard to overlook.

races.name: Nelson Restaurant For Classic Raceday Dining Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Betelgeuse
runners_data.comment: Without a win but rarely far away, with three runner-up efforts in his last five starts (2nd, 3rd, 5th, 2nd, 2nd). A rating of 70 makes him the pick of this field, with today's 12f trip already proven just 18 days after his last run.

runners_data.name: Joanna Hiffernan
runners_data.comment: Without a win in three runs (4th, 4th, 6th) and rated only 60 by our figures, a shade below her official mark of 62. Fit again after 26 days off and with the 12f trip no issue, but there is little in the recent form to get excited about.

runners_data.name: Lenny's Spirit
runners_data.comment: A modest sequence on paper (7th, unplaced, 8th, 6th, 5th, 3rd) masks a rating of 70, level with this field's top figure and well clear of his official mark of 62. Fit again after 23 days off over a proven 12f trip, he rates a live threat to the front two.

runners_data.name: Trojan Truth
runners_data.comment: Twice runner-up in his last five starts (6th, 2nd, 6th, 3rd, 2nd) without getting his head in front, and a rating of 67 puts him clear of his official mark of 61. Fit again after 24 days off over a proven 12f trip, he remains one of the more consistent form horses here.

runners_data.name: Spec Of Light
runners_data.comment: A mixed sequence of 8th, 8th, 5th, 7th, 2nd and 7th in his last six hides a rating of 64, well clear of his official mark of 56. Quick to back up just 12 days after his latest run over a proven 12f trip, that one big placed effort stands out.

runners_data.name: Ottoman
runners_data.comment: 5th, 2nd, 3rd, 8th and an unplaced effort in his last five leave him bottom of these ratings at 58, albeit still above his official mark of 53. Backed up quickly just 5 days after that last run over a proven 12f trip, but a place in this company looks the ceiling.

races.name: Join Racing TV Today Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: The Bear Of Saints
runners_data.comment: Yet to win but rarely disgraced, a fair second four starts back the standout in a mixed sequence including two unplaced efforts, the latest coming last time out. Proven over today's trip and clear of this field on our figures at 71, despite a 38-day break.

runners_data.name: Dottie Diamond
runners_data.comment: Won last time out to end an underwhelming run, form before that no better than fourth across four earlier starts. Fit having run 26 days ago and proven over today's trip. Rates second on our figures at 65, among the leading dangers here.

runners_data.name: Nzuri
runners_data.comment: Yet to win but capable, a runner-up effort four starts back preceding two modest efforts and a fair fourth last time out. Race-fit on a quick five-day turnaround, proven over today's trip. Rates third on our figures at 60.

runners_data.name: Dreambird Dolly
runners_data.comment: A winner two starts back, and runner-up three starts back, before form dipped to an unplaced effort last time out. Wears tongue-tie and blinkers, fit after 22 days, proven over today's trip; rates fourth on our figures at 60.

runners_data.name: Rainbow Sorbet
runners_data.comment: Yet to win, a mixed set of finishes headed by a third five starts back, nothing better than fourth in the runs since. Race-fit on a quick seven-day turnaround, proven over today's trip, though our rating of 53 has it bottom of this field.

runners_data.name: Port Hedland
runners_data.comment: Won two starts back but form has since dipped, well held in eighth last time out. Wears a hood, race-fit 14 days on, proven over today's trip. Our rating of 58 has it fifth of six.

races.name: Evening Racing @leicesterraces Wednesday 22nd July Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Musical Soldier
runners_data.comment: A win among his last six starts (2nd, unplaced, 2nd, 5th, 1st, 7th) and a runner-up effort last time out hint at a horse retaining ability. A rating of 57 from stall 5, fit again just 6 days on over a proven 7f trip, makes him a leading contender.

runners_data.name: Lope Y Linda
runners_data.comment: Two wins from her last six starts (2nd, 1st, unplaced, 2nd, 1st, 4th) mark her the most progressive runner here, having been runner-up last time out. A rating of 60 makes her second-best on our figures, fit again just 9 days on over a proven 7f trip from stall 6.

runners_data.name: Auspicious
runners_data.comment: One win from his last six starts (unplaced, 2nd, 1st, 5th, 3rd, 7th) was followed by a below-par effort last time out. A rating of 53, in line with his official mark, puts him only fifth here, and 24 days off since that last run leaves questions.

runners_data.name: Gal
runners_data.comment: Modest finishing positions (6th, 3rd, 8th, unplaced, unplaced) mask a rating of 62, well clear of her official mark of 51 and the best of this field on our figures. She returns from 22 days off over a proven 7f trip from stall 3, with the layoff the only slight concern.

runners_data.name: Arvana Belle
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in five starts (7th, unplaced, 6th, 3rd, 2nd) and bottom of these ratings at 49, just a shade above her official mark of 48. A lengthy 35-day break and a proven trip from stall 4 do little to change the picture on this profile.

runners_data.name: Poetic Grace
runners_data.comment: A steady sequence of 5th, 3rd, 4th, 4th and 9th in her last five hides a rating of 55, well clear of her official mark of 45 and fourth-best of this field on our figures. A 35-day absence and a proven trip from stall 2 are the only queries against her chances.

races.name: Leicester Racecourse Ideal Conference Venue Fillies' Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Imola
runners_data.comment: Won three and four starts back, form since more workmanlike with a below-par sixth last time. Eight days since that run, proven over today's trip. Our rating of 70 puts it third of five from stall 2.

runners_data.name: Melody De Vega
runners_data.comment: Yet to win but rarely far away, runner-up last time and twice third in the past five starts, proven over today's trip. Our rating of 80 tops this field, though it's 27 days since that run and the yard is out of form.

runners_data.name: Fille Imbassee
runners_data.comment: Won last time out and six starts back either side of a moderate spell including one finish outside the frame. Fitted with a hood, proven over today's trip. Rated 69 by us, fourth of five, 19 days since that success.

runners_data.name: Hot Silk
runners_data.comment: Yet to win but building a solid case with three consecutive fourths, the latest coming 17 days ago. Proven over today's trip. Our rating of 73 is bettered only by the selection here, ranking second of five from stall 5.

runners_data.name: Bergamo Gold
runners_data.comment: Ranked bottom of this five but not without ability, having landed back-to-back wins before fading to eighth and ninth last twice out. A 57-day absence since, the obvious question mark for an otherwise progressive sort.

races.name: Private Boxes For Best View @leicesterraces Classified Stakes

runners_data.name: Bullington Bry
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in its last six starts, though has been competitive at halfway with fourths three and six runs back. Fitted with blinkers and resuming after a 45-day absence, though proven over today's trip. Our rating of 53 has it third of eleven, a fair yardstick within this field.

runners_data.name: Drish Samphire
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in its last four starts, form modest throughout — a best of fifth four starts back, a seventh last time out. Wears a hood and is race-fit after 26 days, proven over today's trip; our rating of 44 leaves it mid-pack, eighth of eleven.

runners_data.name: Henry Tudor
runners_data.comment: A once-promising sort who won four starts back but has struggled for the frame since, no better than eighth in three runs including last time out. Second highest on our figures at 54, 14 days since that run, from stall 1.

runners_data.name: Manhattan Chute
runners_data.comment: Yet to win and struggling for form, no better than seventh in the last six starts including finishing unplaced. Race-fit on a quick seven-day turnaround and proven over today's trip, but our rating of 39 has it down in tenth of eleven.

runners_data.name: Marisitta
runners_data.comment: Won last time out, though form before that was modest with nothing better than fourth. Wears cheekpieces, race-fit 17 days on and proven over today's trip. Our rating of 46 has it seventh of eleven from stall 11.

runners_data.name: Sir Rodneyredblood
runners_data.comment: Yet to win but consistently competitive, runner-up last time out and again six starts back, with modest form in between including two eighths. Wears cheekpieces and is race-fit having run 18 days ago, proven over today's trip. Tops our figures at 56, albeit in a race with modest form throughout.

runners_data.name: Summer Rain
runners_data.comment: Yet to win, form modest throughout with a best of fifth on two occasions among the last five starts. Wears cheekpieces and is sharp having run just six days ago, proven over today's trip. Our rating of 43 leaves it ninth of eleven.

runners_data.name: Follow My Heart
runners_data.comment: Yet to win, form up and down with a promising third last time out following a run of modest finishes. Wears blinkers, race-fit 14 days on, proven over today's trip. Our rating of 47 places it mid-pack, sixth of eleven.

runners_data.name: Gardening
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in its last three starts, twice fifth before fading to an unplaced effort last time out. Wears a visor, resuming after 26 days off, proven over today's trip, but our rating of 34 has it bottom of this field.

runners_data.name: Rogue Rebellion
runners_data.comment: Yet to win but capable — a fair fourth last time out, a third two runs back, and a runner-up five starts back, with flat efforts in between. Race-fit 11 days on, proven over today's trip; our rating of 50 has him fourth of eleven.

runners_data.name: Saeculamation
runners_data.comment: Yet to win, with a third and two fourths sandwiched in its recent form, though the two most recent efforts have been sixths. Race-fit 14 days on, proven over today's trip. Our rating of 49 has him fifth of eleven.
